A talisman is an equippable item that provides heroes with a passive buff.[1] Each talisman has a level of I, II, or III which increases by earning experience while equipped. The level of a talisman determines the potency of its buffs. Up to three talismans can be equipped at once. Level 1 has a bronze frame around the talisman, level 2 has a silver frame around the talisman, and level 3 has a gold frame around the talisman.

Obtaining

Talismans are rewarded during certain quests or found in special chests hidden throughout the world. There are 8 secret talismans hidden in secret chests. Collecting all 8 unlocks a secret passage in Howling Woods leading to the Mosstrosity boss, which drops the ninth special talisman, the Wonderful Wheat. Only one of each talisman can be obtained.

History

June 7, 2026 Three talismans are seen in the inventory.
June 10, 2026 The Sigil of Beeswax and another talisman are seen in the inventory.
August 17, 2026 Some unnamed talismans are seen in a video.

Trivia

  • The Amethyst Lens is the only talisman that has two methods to obtain it.
  • Obtaining all 8 secret talismans unlocks the Lush Caves in Howling Woods, where the Mosstrosity boss spawns.
